categories.main_business_segments: Beijing OriginWater Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in environmental protection and water treatment, covering a full industry chain. Its main business segments include sewage resource utilization, high-quality drinking water, seawater desalination, industrial zero discharge, and salt lake resource utilization. The company also provides municipal and drainage engineering, operation services, and light technology solutions through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in membrane technology including microfiltration, ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, and reverse osmosis membranes, with proprietary technologies such as MBR (Membrane Bioreactor), V-MBR (Vibration Membrane Bioreactor), and MBR-DF dual membrane new water source technology. It manufactures membranes using PVDF materials and develops integrated systems like intelligent sewage purification and seawater desalination units. The company also develops lithium adsorption materials and advanced catalytic oxidation technologies, emphasizing green, low-energy, and automated production methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include local governments, municipal water utilities, industrial parks, and enterprises requiring wastewater treatment, water supply, and resource recovery solutions. The company serves urban and rural sewage treatment, industrial wastewater, seawater desalination, and salt lake lithium extraction markets. It also targets emerging sectors such as semiconductor ultrapure water and industrial zero discharge. Major end markets are municipal water treatment, industrial water reuse, environmental remediation, and new energy materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Beijing and Tianjin and projects across multiple provinces including Hebei, Shandong, Hubei, and Xinjiang. It has expanded overseas markets in Malaysia, Mauritania, Namibia, Mexico, Russia, and Italy. The company participates in national key ecological regions such as the Yangtze River, Yellow River, and South-to-North Water Diversion areas, and is active in Belt and Road Initiative countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: OriginWater operates across the upstream, midstream, and downstream segments of the water treatment supply chain. It develops and manufactures core membrane materials and equipment (upstream), provides integrated engineering and construction services (midstream), and offers operation and maintenance services for water treatment facilities (downstream). It also engages in resource recovery and new material production such as lithium extraction from salt lakes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on advancing membrane technology innovation, including vibration MBR, high-performance nanofiltration membranes, seawater desalination membranes, and lithium adsorption materials. It invests heavily in R&D to improve energy efficiency, reduce costs, and develop new materials for emerging industries like industrial zero discharge and biopharmaceutical membranes. Strategic priorities include digital water management, green low-carbon manufacturing, and expanding new business areas such as salt lake resource utilization and industrial wastewater zero discharge.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through direct sales of membrane products and equipment, engineering procurement and construction (EPC) contracts, operation and maintenance service fees from PPP/BOT projects, and integrated solution contracts. The company also earns income from technology licensing, government subsidies, and investment returns from subsidiaries and associates. Sales are primarily conducted via direct sales channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: OriginWater is a leading high-tech environmental protection enterprise in China and ranks among the top global membrane manufacturers. It holds a dominant position in large-scale MBR projects and membrane technology innovation. The company competes with domestic and international membrane and water treatment technology providers, leveraging its comprehensive industry chain and proprietary technologies to maintain competitive advantages. It is recognized as a national champion in manufacturing and a leader in the water treatment sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 8.55 billion RMB, a slight decline of 4.51% from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about 58.6 million RMB, down 92.34%. Total assets reached nearly 79.7 billion RMB, with a steady growth trend. Despite short-term profit pressure due to market conditions and losses in some associates, the company maintains a strong asset base and continues to invest in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: OriginWater emphasizes its fully proprietary, full-industry-chain membrane technology and integrated water treatment solutions that deliver high-quality, energy-efficient, and environmentally friendly water reuse and desalination. Its innovative vibration MBR technology reduces energy consumption by over 20%, and its MBR-DF dual membrane process produces high-grade water meeting stringent environmental standards. The company’s products feature high selectivity, durability, and cost-effectiveness, supporting sustainable water resource management and industrial zero discharge, differentiating it from competitors.
